description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Cho'Gath''' empowers its next 3 [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] within 6 seconds to gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range and launch a blast of spikes [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] in the target's direction. Enemies struck are dealt magic damage and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by an amount that decays over 1.5 seconds. The damage is modified against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Active: Cho'Gath empowers its next 3 basic attacks within 6 seconds to gain  50 bonus range and launch a blast of spikes on-attack in the target's direction. Enemies struck are dealt magic damage and slowed by an amount that decays over 1.5 seconds. The damage is modified against monsters.

description2.raw: The width of the blast of spikes increases based on '''Cho'Gath's''' character [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]] modifier when they launch, including but not limited to the bonus from ''[[File:Cho'Gath Feast.png|20xpx|border|link=Cho'Gath#Feast|An icon for Cho'Gath's ability Feast]] [[Cho'Gath#Feast|Feast]]'' stacks.
description2.text: The width of the blast of spikes increases based on Cho'Gath's character size modifier when they launch, including but not limited to the bonus from Feast stacks.

description3.raw: ''Vorpal Spikes [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Cho'Gath's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Vorpal Spikes resets Cho'Gath's basic attack timer.

External size modifiers ([[File:Lulu Wild Growth.png|20xpx|border|link=Lulu#Wild Growth|An icon for Lulu's ability Wild Growth]] [[Lulu#Wild Growth|Wild Growth]]) contribute to this. ** At certain size thresholds, the missile gets replaced by a different one with a different width. notes.text:
The missiles are launched from an offset 25 units in front of Cho'Gath and towards the target's location on-attack-complete.
* When attacking enemies within 25 units center-to-center of Cho'Gath, the missile will fire in the opposite direction.
Cho'Gath's size factors into the wideness of the hitbox Vorpal Spikes has. External size modifiers ( Wild Growth) contribute to this.
* At certain size thresholds, the missile gets replaced by a different one with a different width. At each step, the width grows by 30, except for the 3rd missile, where it only grows by 10.(unexpected)
* Some of the size thresholds are placed very weird.(unexpected)
* The missile range is unchanged.
The empowered attack will trigger but not apply its effects against structures.
